decision_rationale: Introduces COMPASS as an interpretable model for CRISPRi perturbation response in transcriptomes. The abstract mentions gene expression and STRING embeddings, but no substantive text/language component.
evidence_snippet: "Predicting how a genetic perturbation reshapes a cell’s transcriptome"; "predictable from STRING protein-interaction embeddings"

decision_rationale: This is a thesis-style interpretability work applying concept-based methods to existing foundation models across histopathology, NLP, and transcriptomics. The text and bio pieces are separate applications rather than a single text-bio model.
evidence_snippet: "Cette thèse étudie..."; "En transcriptomique"; "Dans une étude complémentaire en traitement automatique du langage naturel"

decision_rationale: Presents scGENet as a framework built on pretrained single-cell foundation-model gene embeddings to derive interpretable gene networks. This is an application on existing models, not a new text-bio foundation model.
evidence_snippet: "constructs context-specific gene interaction networks from foundation model–derived gene embeddings"

decision_rationale: Studies residual-stream geometry in scGPT and Geneformer to assess gene-regulatory signal. The work analyzes existing single-cell foundation models rather than proposing a text-bio model.
evidence_snippet: "scGPT and Geneformer"; "carry incremental, regulatory-relevant geometric signal"

decision_rationale: Evaluates existing single-cell foundation models on CAR T scRNA-seq products to predict persistence and cell composition. This is downstream application of pretrained models, with no text component described.
evidence_snippet: "We applied four scFMs... to paired basal and CD19-stimulated pre-infusion CAR T products"

decision_rationale: Presents a new foundation model for consumer transaction data, not biological data. The abstract is about transaction trajectories and anomaly detection, so it falls outside the bio scope.
evidence_snippet: "a foundation model for consumer transaction data"; "trained on billion-scale real-world transactions"

decision_rationale: This is a benchmarking study comparing multiple foundation models across scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, and Perturb-seq. It is explicitly a benchmark rather than a candidate model paper.
evidence_snippet: "We benchmarked six representative models"; "using a harmonised framework"

decision_rationale: Fine-tunes scGPT and Geneformer on cross-species single-cell data to predict age and analyze attributions. The abstract describes downstream use of existing models, not a new text-bio model.
evidence_snippet: "We fine-tuned scGPT and Geneformer on 1.3 million such cells"
